_about: Drop this object into xeno-store/updates/saves-backend.json (consoles fetch it with the catalog) or paste url + anonKey into Settings → Saves → Backend on the console. The anon key is public by design: row-level security limits it to reading rows, inserting pending submissions and uploading into the bucket. Keep indexUrl so the GitHub index stays merged with the database (deduped by sha256 / garlic id).
